decisions.reason: As a newly launched multi-model specialist system for demanding marine use, it fits the firm's robust application-specific business and recent investment makes management likely to continue with it.
Its own product page shows visible commitment and it can be justified as an ergonomic task-lighting offer, so management is likely to retain it despite any early uncertainty.
This is closest to the firm's core interior-lighting business and future direction in efficient building solutions, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Although it appears less prominently and is only a single product rather than a broad line, it still matches the firm's mainstream application portfolio so management would probably keep it on the market.

The marine HMI searchlight is more niche and less obviously aligned with the stated move toward sustainable intelligent lighting, but the recent launch and line-level investment still favor continuation for now.
This marine searchlight extends the firm's specialist rugged-lighting offer, and under escalation of commitment management is likely to give the new line more time before considering withdrawal.
